explication: Feynman is an AI research agent combining a command-line interface with a local science workbench. The principal workflow is: a researcher submits a research request, CLI routing selects agent/research capabilities, Pi executes model-driven investigation and tool calls, external scientific or web sources provide evidence, and results appear as cited research output or persisted workbench artifacts. The workbench additionally supports chat, projects, notebooks, previews, reviews, provenance, and settings. Arrows reflect sampled source and README behavior; many command implementations were not sampled.
